newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DMCI says unit consolidating subsidiaries.
newsitem.headline: DMCI says unit consolidating subsidiaries.

text.p: DMCI Holdings Inc said on Monday its board and stockholders have approved the merger of its unit DMCI Project Developers Inc with DMCI Project's nine subsidiaries.
The firm said in a statement DMCI Project Developers will emerge as the surviving corporation after its merger with the nine other companies. It did not disclose a reason for the consolidation.
DMCI Holdings said it will file the merger documents with the Securities and Exchange Commission after the completion of the audited financial statements of the companies.
